purpose: Curated authoritative discovery registry for VISUAL. Entries are research leads, not blanket permission to download, redistribute, or train on content.

sources.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility
sources.access_mode: REST API; paged queries and asynchronous downloads
sources.license_policy: Per-dataset license varies; record-level CC0, CC BY and CC BY-NC may occur. Preserve attribution and exclude non-commercial material from commercial training.
sources.download_policy: metadata_first; bulk download only after dataset filters, license manifest and citation are checked
quality_notes: Taxonomic synonym and identifier reconciliation required
Occurrence records can have geospatial, temporal and identification uncertainty
GBIF disclaims guarantee of source-data accuracy

sources.name: Ocean Biodiversity Information System
sources.access_mode: REST API for smaller subsets; GeoParquet exports for large subsets
sources.license_policy: The integrated export is CC BY-NC; underlying source datasets can differ. Inspect the source license manifest before any reuse.
sources.download_policy: do_not_parallelize_bulk_downloads; use documented export method and preserve per-source licenses
quality_notes: OBIS runs initial, automated and manual quality control
Keep provider fields and OBIS-derived QC fields distinguishable

sources.name: Museum für Naturkunde Berlin Animal Sound Archive
sources.access_mode: Archive discovery and GBIF-linked metadata; audio access subject to archive terms
sources.license_policy: GBIF occurrence dataset is listed CC BY 4.0; do not infer that every linked audio file has identical rights. Verify each recording's terms with the archive.
sources.download_policy: no audio bulk download until recording-level permission and license are confirmed
quality_notes: Separate wild recordings from zoo or experimental recordings
Preserve original sample rate, bit depth, recording context and taxon identifier

sources.name: Xeno-canto wildlife sound recordings
sources.access_mode: API v3; API key required
sources.license_policy: License is selected per recording; many recordings are non-commercial or share-alike. Evaluate every recording individually; exclude NC and ND from commercial training.
sources.download_policy: metadata only until key and API terms are configured; audio reuse only after per-recording license review
quality_notes: Do not expose precise locations for sensitive or threatened species
Retain recordist attribution, recording quality, date, location precision and vocalization type

sources.name: iNaturalist observations and media
sources.access_mode: curated exports and documented API; not bulk scraping
sources.license_policy: Observation records and media carry varying licenses. Dataset exports include CC0, CC BY and CC BY-NC observations; filter per record and media asset.
sources.download_policy: prefer official exports; respect API media rate limits; do not assume observation license covers linked media
quality_notes: Presence-only observations have sampling and observer bias
Preserve geoprivacy and obscured-location rules
Identifications may change over time

sources.name: OpenNeuro
sources.access_mode: public dataset browser, documented command-line/API and DataLad workflows
sources.license_policy: OpenNeuro submissions are required to use CC0; still verify the dataset snapshot and accompanying participant/privacy constraints before processing.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; no human-subject bulk data download until privacy, consent, defacing, BIDS validation and storage checks pass
quality_notes: Use BIDS validation
Preserve dataset version and DOI
Neuroimaging is not a direct measurement of intelligence or a clinical diagnosis

sources.name: Neuroelectromagnetic Data Archive and Tools Resource
sources.access_mode: dataset discovery and per-dataset access
sources.license_policy: Dataset licenses vary, including public-domain, attribution, non-commercial, no-derivatives and custom/unknown. Filter each dataset individually.
sources.download_policy: no automated bulk download; use public-license filters and dataset-level terms
quality_notes: Preserve event annotations, channel metadata, montage and quality information
Human-subject privacy and consent review required

sources.name: Allen Institute Brain Map and Cell Atlas
sources.access_mode: documented API, SDK and project-specific downloads
sources.license_policy: Allen Institute Terms of Use and citation policy apply; do not label all content CC0 or assume commercial reuse permission.
sources.download_policy: metadata and code examples first; verify applicable terms and citation policy per resource
quality_notes: Record species, brain region, assay, developmental stage and experimental protocol

sources.name: NASA Earthdata
sources.access_mode: NASA Common Metadata Repository and product-specific services
sources.license_policy: Many NASA datasets are openly accessible, but product-specific notices, third-party content and access credentials may apply. Check each product record.
sources.download_policy: product-level review, spatial/temporal subset and checksum before download
quality_notes: Record sensor, collection version, processing level, calibration and uncertainty

sources.name: Hugging Face Datasets Hub
data_types: text, image, audio and video dataset references
sources.access_mode: Hub API and dataset cards
sources.license_policy: Dataset licenses and upstream provenance vary. A public Hub listing is not evidence that every file is legally reusable.
sources.download_policy: metadata only until dataset card, upstream source, license, privacy and file manifest are reviewed
quality_notes: Check train/test contamination, benchmark leakage, duplicates, personal data and dataset-card completeness

sources.name: Zenodo
sources.access_mode: REST API and record files
sources.license_policy: License is record- and file-specific. Check the deposited record and every file; do not assume a repository-wide license.
sources.download_policy: record metadata first; download only after file-level license and checksum verification
quality_notes: Record DOI, version, creators, publication date, related identifiers and file checksums

sources.name: PubMed
sources.access_mode: NCBI E-utilities
sources.license_policy: Bibliographic metadata access does not grant reuse rights to article abstracts, full text, figures or supplementary data. Check publisher and PMC license status.
sources.download_policy: metadata-first; full text only from sources with explicit reuse permissions
quality_notes: Retain PMID, DOI, publication type, retraction/correction status and publication date

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.access_mode: REST API and snapshot
sources.license_policy: OpenAlex metadata is CC0; linked full text has separate rights and must be reviewed independently.
sources.download_policy: metadata API first; do not mirror linked papers without their own license check
quality_notes: Disambiguate authors and institutions; record work identifiers and metadata update time

sources.name: Crossref
sources.access_mode: REST API
sources.license_policy: Bibliographic metadata is CC0; abstracts and full text may have separate rights. Do not ingest abstracts based on metadata license alone.
sources.download_policy: metadata-only
quality_notes: Normalize DOI, preserve deposited dates and correction/retraction relations

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.access_mode: documented APIs and dumps
sources.license_policy: Structured data is CC0; linked media and external descriptions may carry separate licenses.
sources.download_policy: respect API policy; preserve references and statement qualifiers
quality_notes: Statements can be disputed, incomplete or time-dependent; retain references and retrieval timestamp

sources.name: DANDI Archive
sources.access_mode: DANDI API and versioned asset downloads
sources.license_policy: Dataset and asset-level licenses and consents must be checked; human and animal research data may carry additional restrictions.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; download only public versioned assets after license, consent, checksum and storage review
quality_notes: Preserve NWB schema and DANDI version identifier
Validate subject/session metadata and privacy constraints

sources.name: NASA Open Science Data Repository
sources.access_mode: NASA OSDR search, metadata and data-file APIs
sources.license_policy: Check each study, file, third-party contribution and data-use condition; remove or protect sensitive participant information.
sources.download_policy: metadata search first; select study files after rights, privacy and checksum review
quality_notes: Record study accession, assay, organism, mission and experimental conditions
Preserve raw and processed data distinctions

sources.name: Brain Image Library
sources.access_mode: Public dataset discovery and repository-specific downloads
sources.license_policy: Review dataset-specific license, consent, attribution and specimen provenance.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; large imaging downloads require storage preflight and manifest/checksum validation
quality_notes: Preserve voxel dimensions, orientation, modality, staining and acquisition metadata
Distinguish species, brain region and developmental stage

sources.name: OpenNeuro PET
sources.access_mode: Public dataset archive and documented access methods
sources.license_policy: Verify dataset snapshot license, participant consent, de-identification and any data-use limitations individually.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; no bulk download before privacy, license and BIDS checks
quality_notes: Record tracer, acquisition protocol, scanner, preprocessing and BIDS validation status

sources.name: Earth Species Project alp-data
sources.access_mode: Python package with per-dataset loaders; dataset-specific upstream access
sources.license_policy: Each upstream dataset retains its own license and terms; inspect per-dataset documentation before download or training.
sources.download_policy: No blanket bulk mirror; use per-dataset loader only after upstream rights and checksums verified
quality_notes: Preserve upstream dataset identity and original annotations
Check subject, site and recording-session leakage
Validate sample rate, channel count and duration

sources.name: Bioacoustics datasets index
sources.access_mode: Curated index; follow original dataset repositories
sources.license_policy: Index entry does not establish underlying dataset license; inspect original repository and recording-level terms.
sources.download_policy: Harvest catalog metadata only; download original datasets only after item-level license and access checks
quality_notes: Check taxonomic coverage and annotation quality
Record recording hours and geographic coverage
Avoid mixing benchmark test sets into training

sources.name: Collaborative Research in Computational Neuroscience
sources.access_mode: Dataset-specific repository access and data-use terms
sources.license_policy: Terms and data-use agreements vary by dataset; do not assume open commercial reuse.
sources.download_policy: Metadata-first; honor registration and dataset-specific agreement
quality_notes: Preserve experimental protocol, species, task, electrode metadata and labels
Check subject/session splits and data-use restrictions

sources.name: NeuroTycho
sources.access_mode: Dataset portal and dataset-specific download terms
sources.license_policy: Verify portal and dataset-specific reuse conditions; animal neural data are not automatically CC0.
sources.download_policy: No automatic downloads until access and license terms are verified
quality_notes: Preserve sampling rate, channel layout, task events and animal/session identity

sources.name: FAO AGRIS Open Data Set
sources.access_mode: Open Data Set download and catalog metadata
sources.license_policy: AGRIS ODS metadata is CC BY 4.0; linked full texts retain their own licenses.
sources.download_policy: Metadata may be reused with attribution; inspect linked article and dataset rights separately
quality_notes: Preserve Dublin Core and Data Catalog fields
Normalize DOI and institutional identifiers
Do not infer rights for linked full text

sources.name: World Resources Institute Data Explorer
sources.access_mode: Dataset catalog and per-dataset downloads
sources.license_policy: Check each dataset's license, attribution and source terms individually.
sources.download_policy: Metadata first; download only after per-dataset terms and file manifest are verified
quality_notes: Record spatial and temporal resolution, units, methodology and uncertainty

sources.name: UN Biodiversity Lab
sources.access_mode: Dataset catalog and provider-specific geospatial layers
sources.license_policy: Licenses vary by data provider and layer; verify each layer's reuse terms.
sources.download_policy: Catalog metadata first; obtain layer-specific terms before downloads
quality_notes: Retain provider, spatial resolution, projection and version
Respect restricted national workspaces and sensitive species locations

quality_gates: No record is training-eligible until item-level license, attribution, privacy and consent checks pass.
Do not combine metadata license with linked file license.
Validate schema, identifiers, dates, units, taxonomic names and coordinate ranges.
Keep raw immutable source metadata separate from normalized fields and derived labels.
Store source URL, accessed timestamp, version, license evidence and SHA-256 for every downloaded file.
Deduplicate exact hashes and flag near-duplicates; do not discard provenance when merging.
Split ML data by subject, individual, recording session, site or source group as appropriate to prevent leakage.
Use independent human review for ambiguous labels and sensitive biological or clinical interpretation.
For animal audio, preserve sample rate, channels, duration, recorder, habitat, weather, distance, species confidence and vocalization context.
For human neuroscience/clinical data, enforce consent, de-identification, data-use agreements and access controls.
Treat missing, contradictory or uncertain metadata as unknown; never infer a permissive license or ground-truth label.
